title: Strategic Spell Damage Optimization
description: A magician has several spells, each with a specific damage value. Casting a spell with damage d prevents you from casting any other spells with damage d-2, d-1, d+1, or d+2. Each spell can be used once. Maximize the total damage output by selecting an optimal subset of spells.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of spells.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing spell damage values.
output_format: Print the maximum total damage possible by selecting an optimal set of spells.
